basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Bristol Think Big Postgraduate Scholarship
basic_details.major_restrictions: All full-time one-year postgraduate taught master's programmes across Bristol faculties (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Public Policy, Life Sciences).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 Think Big postgraduate awards (tuition fee waivers of GBP 6,500, GBP 13,000, and up to GBP 26,000) annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; approximately 6 to 12 Pakistani master's students secure Think Big scholarships each academic year

nationality_requirements: Overseas fee-paying international students from all countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction under University of Bristol admissions policies.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with high upper second-class or first-class honors (minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 or 75%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive candidates for the top GBP 26,000 award typically hold CGPA >= 3.65 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught master's programme at the University of Bristol.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to September 2027.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Relevant internships, community leadership, or social initiatives provide valuable material for the three scholarship essay questions.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in all bands) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (no band below 20). MOI certificates are not accepted by Bristol.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must demonstrate exceptional potential to be a global ambassador and contribute to Bristol's vibrant student community.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another full UK government scholarship (e.g. Chevening or Commonwealth).

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition fee waiver up to GBP 26,000 (covers 100% of most master's programmes; remaining tuition covered via departmental bursary).

admission_application_fee.details: Applying for most postgraduate taught programmes at Bristol is free of charge via the online application system.

accommodation.details: Priority access to University of Bristol postgraduate residences across Clifton and city centre.

monthly_stipend.details: GBP 500 / month living stipend (~PKR 185,000 / month) provided through Think Big living bursaries (GBP 3,000 to GBP 6,000 total per academic year).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Bristol is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa fee (~GBP 490) and Immigration Health Surcharge (~GBP 776/year) covered by student.
visa_fee.amount: UK Visa & IHS fees borne by candidate

health_insurance.details: Full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) throughout the duration of the master's programme.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized student cafeterias across Bristol campus and shared self-catering residence kitchens.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to Bristol University Library system and online academic journals.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to high-performance computing facilities (BlueCrystal supercomputer) and engineering labs.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized student bus travel in Bristol via First Bus student passes and 16-25 Railcard discount.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Bristol, Bristol, UK).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 55 university (QS World University Rankings 2025); Russell Group member.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree with CGPA >= 3.30 / 4.00, IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+, Bristol admission offer, and completed Think Big scholarship essay form.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) for a master's programme at Bristol before applying for Think Big.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus scholarship essay on concrete examples of initiative and how you will give back as a Bristol ambassador.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Bristol Online Application Portal & Think Big Form
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for an eligible master's programme at Bristol. Step 2: Receive 9-digit Bristol student ID. Step 3: Complete the online Think Big scholarship application form answering the three prescribed essay questions before April 26.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Research eligible one-year taught master's programmes at Bristol and submit course application.
Step 2: Receive your 9-digit University of Bristol student ID number upon course application submission.
Step 3: Access the Think Big Postgraduate Scholarship online form on the Bristol International website.
Step 4: Answer the three scholarship essay prompts (200 words each): (1) Special attributes/achievements, (2) Future plans, (3) Contribution to Bristol community.
Step 5: Submit the Think Big application before the deadline (Round 1: February 26, Round 2: April 26).
Step 6: Selection panel evaluates applications and scores essays.
Step 7: Scholarship decisions communicated by late May.
Step 8: Accept scholarship award within the specified deadline and initiate UK Student Visa application.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first apply for master's admission, then submit the Think Big scholarship application form using their student ID.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as part of the initial course application via referee upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Three specific 200-word questions: (1) Outline any special attributes or achievements, (2) How will your chosen course help you achieve future goals, (3) How will you contribute to the University of Bristol community.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated within the course personal statement.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV submitted with the course application.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are made exclusively on academic credentials and the three Think Big essay answers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 90+ (min 20 each).
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 0 (free to apply for most courses and free for scholarship)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via University of Bristol Think Big application form.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in relevant academic field (minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00).
Complete transcripts of undergraduate records showing all course marks and grades.
Proof of application or offer letter containing 9-digit Bristol student ID.
Answers to the three mandatory 200-word questions explaining achievements, career goals, and community contribution.
Academic CV detailing qualifications, coding projects, and extracurriculars.
Recommendation letter from university professor submitted with course application.
Official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 90) test certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Think Big operates two application rounds: Round 1 closes February 26; Round 2 closes April 26 (10:00 AM UK time).

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 20% (Community leadership and extracurricular initiative in Essay 1)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 25% (Quality of vision and community contribution in Essays 2 and 3)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Bristol International Scholarships Committee and Faculty Representatives.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring rubric assessing intellectual merit, future ambition, and capacity to act as a global ambassador.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,000 to 4,500 international applicants for Think Big scholarships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 6% among applicants holding strong GPAs and compelling essays
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.60 / 4.00 (Upper Second Class Honours or First Class equivalent)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates across STEM, business, and humanities with solid academic records and dedicated social or community involvement.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, IBA Karachi, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Malaysia, Kenya, Indonesia, Ghana.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through the official University of Bristol portal https://www.bristol.ac.uk/.
Never pay any fee to agents claiming to secure Think Big scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for Think Big is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Bristol explicitly states that scholarship essays must be the applicant's own work; agency-written generic essays are penalized.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight from Pakistan to London/Bristol: ~PKR 150,000 to 220,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need to be a First Class student to apply. Reality: Students holding strong 2:1 equivalency (CGPA 3.3+) with outstanding essay answers frequently win awards.

Myth: The scholarship covers all living costs. Reality: The main award is a tuition fee waiver; additional living bursaries (GBP 3,000) provide valuable support but students should plan for remaining maintenance.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim essays have no word count limit; Bristol strictly enforces a 200-word limit per essay question, with excess words penalized.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance throughout the master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study attendance; scholars must agree to participate in international student promotional activities and ambassador events.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term academic progress monitoring by the faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 20 hours per week during term time under UK Student Visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Act as a Think Big Student Ambassador during the year of study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of award if student withdraws from programme or engages in disciplinary breach.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Subject change allowed only within eligible Bristol postgraduate taught programmes with faculty approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the 1-year duration of the postgraduate taught master's programme.
